title: FVH-Bench: Evaluating Image Generator Safety Beyond Overtly Harmful Imagery
abstract: arXiv:2610.37722v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Modern image generators can produce complex visual artifacts, including diagrams, interfaces, and records that combine text, graphics, and layout to convey detailed information. They may refuse requests for overtly harmful imagery yet still generate artifacts that guide dangerous actions or support deception. We call the risk arising from what such images enable, rather than only what they depict, functional visual harm (FVH). Existing safety benchmarks focus largely on overtly harmful content, such as pornography and graphic violence, leaving image generators' safety alignment against FVH insufficiently evaluated. To address this gap, we introduce FVH-Bench, comprising 669 prompts across five harmful visual functions and ten risk domains. translated_title: FVH-Bench：超越显性有害图像的图像生成器安全性评估
translated_abstract: 现代图像生成器能够生成复杂的视觉产物，包括将文本、图形和布局相结合以传递详细信息的图表、界面和记录等。这些生成器可能会拒绝生成显性有害图像的请求，但仍会生成能够引导危险行为或支持欺骗活动的产物。我们将这种由图像所“能够实现的功能”（而非仅仅其“所描绘的内容”）引发的风险称为功能性视觉伤害。现有的安全基准主要关注色情、血腥暴力等显性有害内容，导致图像生成器针对FVH的安全对齐评估不足。为填补这一空白，我们提出了FVH-Bench，其中包含跨越五种有害视觉功能和十个风险领域的669个提示词。被评估的11个图像生成器很少拒绝这些请求，并频繁生成能够实现目标有害功能的产物，在目标危害实现程度和有害产物质量方面均获得了较高的分数。
tldr: 该论文提出FVH-Bench基准，通过跨越五种有害视觉功能和十个风险领域的669个提示词，揭示了主流图像生成器虽能拒绝显性有害内容，却经常生成可引导危险行为或支持欺骗的“功能性视觉伤害”图像，暴露了现有安全对齐的严重不足。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces FVH-Bench, a benchmark of 669 prompts spanning five harmful visual functions and ten risk domains, revealing that image generators rarely refuse such requests and frequently produce "functional visual harm" artifacts that guide dangerous actions or support deception, despite refusing overtly harmful imagery.
